mapper.select: SELECT REG_CODE prdRegistCode, #{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS hodeDate, VDATE prdVDate, MDATE prdMDate FROM objRec A LEFT JOIN CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB B ON (A.REG_CODE = B.PRD_REGIST_CODE AND B.STATUS IN ('01','02') ) WHERE TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(B.HOLD_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyy-MM-dd') = TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND B.PRD_REGIST_CODE is null
